solutions.cbt_reframing: Identify the 'worst-case scenario' and calculate the realistic probability. Shift from 'What if?' to 'What is right now?'
solutions.somatic_anchor: 5-4-3-2-1 Sensory Grounding: Name 5 things you see, 4 you feel, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, and 1 you taste.
solutions.pranayama: Nadi Shodhana (Alternate Nostril Breathing) for 5 minutes to reduce autonomic sympathetic tone.
solutions.micro_habit: Schedule a dedicated 15-minute 'Worry Window' in the afternoon; postpone rumination until then.

name: Nervous Exhaustion & Clinical Burnout
core_symptoms: Sense of inefficacy and brain fog

solutions.cbt_reframing: Reframe rest as non-negotiable physiological maintenance rather than an earned reward.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Somatic body scan: Lie flat, release the jaw and tongue from the roof of the mouth, unclench pelvic floor.
solutions.pranayama: Bharmari (Humming Bee Breath) to stimulate the vagus nerve and promote parasympathetic tone.
solutions.micro_habit: Implement hard boundaries: Disconnect communication channels at a fixed hour every evening.

name: Acute Panic & Autonomic Dysregulation
core_symptoms: Sudden heart palpitations and racing pulse
cognitive_distortions: Interoceptive Catastrophizing ('My heart is racing, so I must be dying')

solutions.cbt_reframing: Recognize the panic surge as a harmless false-alarm adrenaline dump that naturally subsides within 10–12 minutes.
solutions.somatic_anchor: Mammalian Dive Reflex: Splash ice-cold water onto the face or hold an ice cube in the palm to drop heart rate rapidly.
solutions.pranayama: Extended Exhale Breathing (Inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 2, exhale slowly through pursed lips for 7 seconds).
solutions.micro_habit: Repeat aloud: 'This is uncomfortable, but it is not dangerous. My nervous system is discharging energy.'
